first_step_test: One rounded dome and two tapering sides form an open-bottom glass envelope; the narrow neck gives every later part an obvious attachment.

source.notes: Six cumulative graphite panels; current US past-day Google Trends light-bulb query +200%. Direct keeper contours; no temporary guides. Selected source panels 1,3,4,5,6 as five meaningful steps. Smooth-base intermediate retained privately; the published step draws the threaded base directly.

final_elements.name: glass envelope
final_elements.description: One rounded glass dome narrows into two neck ends at the bottom.

final_elements.name: base collar
final_elements.description: One shallow closed band connects both neck ends.

final_elements.name: screw shell
final_elements.description: One short tapered metal base sits directly beneath the collar.

final_elements.name: contact button
final_elements.description: One small rounded electrical contact closes the bottom of the base.

final_elements.name: upper thread
final_elements.description: Upper curved diagonal raised band wraps around the metal shell.

final_elements.description: Middle curved diagonal raised band wraps around the metal shell.

final_elements.name: lower thread

final_elements.name: central stem
final_elements.description: One narrow glass stem rises from collar into the lower envelope.

final_elements.name: left support wire
final_elements.description: One angled wire runs from stem toward the upper left inside the bulb.

final_elements.name: right support wire
final_elements.description: One angled wire runs from stem toward the upper right inside the bulb.

final_elements.name: filament
final_elements.description: One small coiled filament joins the two support tips.

final_elements.name: left reflection
final_elements.description: One long curved reflection follows the upper left glass wall.

final_elements.name: right reflection
final_elements.description: One shorter curved reflection follows the lower right glass wall.

final_elements.name: ground shadow
final_elements.description: One loose horizontal pencil shadow sits beneath the contact button.

final_elements.name: stem cap

final_elements.name: stem center line
final_elements.description: One fine inner line rises through the narrow central glass stem.

frames.visible_job: Draw a rounded dome above the middle of the page. Bring both sides down and inward into a narrow neck, leaving the bottom open. Keep the widest part above the neck and use two smooth shoulder curves.
frames.instruction: Draw a rounded dome above the middle of the page. Bring both sides down and inward into a narrow neck, leaving the bottom open. Keep the widest part above the neck and use two smooth shoulder curves.

frames.visible_job: Join the two open neck ends with a shallow curved collar band. Beneath it, draw a short tapered screw base with three raised diagonal bands, then add one small rounded contact button at the bottom. Let the bands form the side edges of the shell and shade their lower edges lightly.

final_step.visible_job: Shade the established glass envelope and threaded metal base.
final_step.instruction: Glaze pale blue-gray along the established glass edges, leaving the middle and both reflections nearly white. Shade the metal shell with ochre pencil, deepen the three threads and contact with graphite, and soften the existing ground shadow.

visual_review.first_step_observation: The first saved crop contains only an open-bottom bulb contour: rounded crown, left shoulder, right shoulder and two narrow neck ends. It has no detached guides or premature filament.
visual_review.draw_through_observation: Five saved stages teach the empty envelope, complete ribbed base, internal filament assembly, two reflection shapes with grounding, then edge value. Selecting out the smooth-base intermediate removes the need to erase the shell sides. Direct keeper lines persist; no guide removal is needed.

transitions.observed_addition: A shallow collar connects both neck ends. Three distinct raised diagonal bands form the tapered screw shell and its scalloped side edges; the rounded dark contact sits centered below. The original crown and both shoulder curves persist.
transitions.instruction_match: The base instruction now draws all three raised bands directly and includes light shading; it does not teach a smooth shell that must later disappear.

transitions.observed_addition: A narrow stem rises from the middle of the collar with a fine inner line and oval cap. Left and right support wires rise from that cap to the ends of a compact horizontal coil. Upper, middle and lower screw bands remain separately visible, and the contact retains its small white glint.
transitions.instruction_match: The copy explicitly names stem sides, center line, oval cap, both sloping wires and the connecting coil. The collar and glass envelope provide fixed attachment references.

transitions.observed_addition: A long enclosed reflection appears along the upper-left glass wall, and a shorter enclosed reflection appears lower right. A loose graphite shadow spreads below the contact. The stem cap, center line, both wires and filament remain intact; all three base bands and the collar keep their outlines.
transitions.instruction_match: The reflection instruction matches the two newly enclosed white shapes and the grounding strokes, with no new wiring or changes to the base.

transitions.observed_addition: Pale blue-gray pencil follows the crown and both glass sides; the long left and short right reflections remain white at their original walls. Ochre covers the existing collar and three raised base bands. The stem, its cap and center line, left/right wires and complete coil remain dark and connected, and the contact and shadow deepen.
transitions.instruction_match: The final copy adds only blue-gray glass edge shading, ochre metal, darker threads/contact and a softer existing ground shadow. It preserves the transparent paper center and both reflection shapes.
